scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c green,blue "npm run dev --workspace @paraiso/web" "npm run start:dev --workspace @paraiso/api"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @paraiso/api && npm run build --workspace @paraiso/web
scripts.db:push: npm run db:generate && npm run prisma:push --workspace @paraiso/api
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:generate && npm run prisma:migrate --workspace @paraiso/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:generate && npm run prisma:seed --workspace @paraiso/api
